description: Answers US homeowners, condo, renters, landlord, flood, earthquake, wildfire, coverage-gap and claim questions with cited knowledge-base sources when available, practical next steps and missing facts. Requires a connected Coverage Cat account and the user’s explicitly confirmed location in CA, FL, NY, TX or WA. Ask for their state before the first call; never infer it. No quotes, binding, account lookup, document uploads or claim submission. Send non-identifying questions only. Limited to two requests per minute, twenty per day per account and one request at a time; each query has one bounded model call.

context.description: Optional non-identifying coverage needs, deductibles, occupancy and follow-up context, at most 4,000 UTF-8 bytes. No addresses, account numbers or documents.

property_type.description: The kind of property coverage the user is asking about, if known.

question.description: Property insurance question, at most 4,000 UTF-8 bytes. Omit personal identifiers, contact details, credentials and policy documents.

state.description: The user's location, explicitly confirmed by the user before the first call. Required for eligibility. Never infer or default it.

name: property_insurance_advice
title: Property insurance advice
